opening_loop_L1_10.rule: Exercise all currently implemented segments of move->gather->carry->deliver->transform->build/service/defend-rescue->save-reload; future unavailable segments are explicit N/A, regressions are not.

level_1_100_reachability.rule: Graph/unlock/cost reachability uses placeholders where content is not authored; no dead ends or impossible prerequisites.

population_stress.rule: Routing contention, occupancy, spawn/despawn, identity persistence and budget stress.

contextual_action_arbitration.rule: Priority, tool/weapon selection, cancellation, contact authority, resource conservation and interruption recovery.

economy_security.rule: Idempotence, replay/duplication, grant authority, rollback and F2P reachability.

liveops_virtual_clock.rule: DST, leap day, timezone/clock skew, offline return, overlap, kill switch, duplicate reward and rollback.

region_template.rule: Entry/exit, resource registration, save continuity, streaming/performance and transport hooks.

accessibility_device_smoke.rule: Text scale, touch target, contrast/color differentiation, reduced motion, controller/foldable layout.

physical_reconnaissance.rule: Non-certification named-device reconnaissance for frame time, memory, thermals and native resolution. Never substitutes final certification.
